body:
# Zet's Grace: Craft Equipment
![Uncraftable Equipment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b145b6ba2953adb46839d55aa1411df49354e6b0.png)


## Description
Not too expensive and fitting recipes for uncraftable items, mostly equipment.

Recipes meant to reduce frustrating grinding, but not to remove it completely.


## Features
Adds recipes for:
- **Chainmail Armor**
- **Horse Armor**
- **Nautilus Armor** _(Since 1.21.11)_
- **Trident**
- **Elytra**
- **Heavy Core** _(Since 1.21)_
- **Enchanted Golden Apple**
- **Totem of Undying**
- **Saddle** _(Before 1.21.6)_
- **Name Tag** _(Before 26.1)_


## Other
Part of [Zet's Grace Collection](https://modrinth.com/collection/4Hmh13Uh).
